messages:
Marta (product): Final OKR draft uploaded — need final signoff by EOD today. Link: https://redwood.internal/okrs/2026-draft. Key deltas: tighten latency SLO (p95), Dedicated revenue +12% net, add Privacy Readiness metric (audit/KMS). Please reply with :thumbsup: or short notes.
Becky (product-ops): Quick Q — for Privacy Readiness, is that gated by Private GA or by policy/controls being in place? Need concrete launch criteria.
Marta (product): Good call. Proposal: Privacy Readiness = KMS integration + audit logs enabled + documented data flow. Gate at Private GA. I'll add the wording in the doc.
Lin (engineering): Latency SLO — where's our baseline? Our current hosted p95 ~140ms. 120ms is a tight ask unless we enable more aggressive batching/quantization. Can we make it phased: 120ms for 50% of traffic by EOY, 95% by end of Q2?
Samir (research): Agree with Lin. We should budget a small research spike (kernel selection + long-seq perf) — 2 sprints to validate.
Olivia (finance): Dedicated revenue +12% — what's the ARR baseline? Need explicit numbers for the finance deck and renewals forecast.
Marta (product): Baseline is current committed Dedicated ARR = $6.5M; +12% => $7.28M. Will add exact table in the doc and ping the finance sheet. @Olivia i'll DM the model.
Ethan (CEO): @Marta two asks before I sign off: 1) adopt Lin's phased latency wording; 2) add a customer-impact fallback metric — e.g., % of requests degraded during capacity events <1%. If both in, i can sign off.
Marta (product): Will do. Draft updated inline: `p95_hosted: phase1 (50% traffic) 120ms by EOY; phase2 (global) 95% traffic 120ms by Q2` and `fallback_degrade_rate <1%`. Added Privacy gating language too. PTAL.
Becky (product-ops): LGTM from product ops. :thumbsup: still need legal to confirm privacy wording but operationally this is good.
Samir (research): :eyes: on the research spike. I'll carve out two engineers for a 4-week spike starting next sprint.
Olivia (finance): Finance is okay with the +12% if we stick to committed ARR baseline and note backfill risk. :+1:
Ethan (CEO): :thumbsup: I sign off on the OKRs with the changes above. Go ahead and lock the doc. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Marta (product): Thanks all — locking doc now (version v3.2). Closing the loop and creating follow-ups for: 1) legal privacy signoff, 2) research spike ticket, 3) latency rollout plan. Closing thread.
